title: Electron Lorentz force direction
description: Essential: Student must state that the Lorentz force on a free electron is along the +z direction.

title: Net force expression
description: Essential: Student must derive or present the correct expression F_{nz} = e(I_n B/(n e a b) + E).

title: Particle count derivation
description: Important: Student must correctly derive N_n = n a c v_{nz} Δt and N_p = p a c v_{pz} Δt using density and volume swept.

title: Current balance condition
description: Important: Student must state that the z-direction currents from electrons and holes must be equal in magnitude and opposite in direction (or N_n = N_p).

title: Lorentz force reasoning
description: Important: Student must correctly apply the right-hand rule (or left-hand rule for electrons) to determine force direction from given v_x and B_y.

title: Velocity-current relation
description: Optional: Student uses I_n = n e a b v_{nx} to relate current to drift velocity for substitution.

title: Sign error in force
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns the direction of the Lorentz force (e.g., -z) or misapplies sign for electron charge.

title: Area confusion
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect cross-sectional area (e.g., b×c instead of a×b) when calculating particle count or substituting for v_{nx}.
